name: flin-ga4-mcp
description: Explore Google Analytics 4 reports, traffic, pages and realtime activity with read-only access.
long_description: Connect Google Analytics 4 to Claude Desktop. Requires a Google Cloud Desktop OAuth client with Analytics Data and Admin APIs enabled. Browser sign-in opens on the first data call. Tokens stay locally; report requests go to Google and results return to Claude. No Analytics write operations are exposed.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Client ID from your Google Cloud OAuth client of type Desktop app.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret belonging to the same Desktop app OAuth client.

default_property_id.title: Default GA4 property ID (optional)
default_property_id.description: Numeric property ID, e.g. 123456789. Not a G- measurement ID.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check local configuration and saved sign-in status.

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: List accessible GA accounts and properties.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Read property timezone, currency and tier.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check core-report metric and dimension compatibility.

tools.name: get_top_pages
tools.description: Find top pages by hostname and path.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Run custom GA4 reports with filters and pagination.

tools.name: get_property_configuration
tools.description: Read selected tracking, key event, custom definition, attribution and retention settings.

tools.name: batch_run_reports
tools.description: Run up to five reports on one property.

tools.name: search_change_history
tools.description: Read configuration changes with appropriate Editor/Administrator access.
